messages:
ashley: Quick question — for the rollout UI, how do we surface 'who changed routing policies' in audit exports? Need it for compliance review :eyes:
liam: We currently log actor_id + event, but reviewers want readable names + justification. Adding actor_display and reason would help.
priyanka: tagging on PII risk — display names may be sensitive depending on export mode. We should support pseudonymized actor fields and a mapping file.
ashley: agreed. Maybe add actor_display and actor_pseudonym fields, and an export flag to include mapping if allowed by tenant config.
sophie: retention q: how long do we keep change events in the console vs exports? Legal asked for 7 years for some customers.
liam: console UI can show a compact 90-day view by default, full export/archival for long retention. Export should be NDJSON with per-line metadata.
ashley: sample NDJSON shape proposal?
liam: 
```json
{"ts":"2024-11-02T14:12:03Z","event":"routing.policy.update","tenant":"acme","actor_id":"u_123","actor_display":"Liam H.","actor_pseudonym":"acct-9x2","policy_id":"route-prod-v2","policy_version":17,"change":{"field":"route","from":"gcp-eu","to":"gcp-us"},"justification":"rollback due to perf regressions","routing_decision_meta":{"latency_slo_ms":120,"quota_bucket":"gold"}}
```
ashley: love that. also want telemetry labels so trace -> trace spans can connect UI events to infra traces.
ops-eng: can we add trace_id and request_id? that makes correlation easy for SRE.
priyanka: +1 for trace_id, but need to strip traces when exporting public copies (PII/infra metadata).
sophie: UX idea: in rollout detail pane show a collapsible 'audit evidence' section with a Download export button and a small privacy toggle (include actor mapping?)
ashley: should Download honor tenant export quotas? we already have export jobs that count against daily export quota.
ops-eng: yes, tie to Export Quota API. If over quota, show preview (compact timeline) and link to raise request.
liam: API debate: do we expose a single /audit/export endpoint or separate /audit/rollouts and /audit/changes? Preference for single endpoint with filters.
priyanka: single endpoint + envelope type field. simpler for compliance consumers.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: audit-schema-v3 rolled out to staging at 2024-11-02T16:00Z :rocket:
ashley: OK next actions — liam to draft NDJSON schema + fields whitelist; priyanka to list pseudonymization patterns and retention controls; sophie to mock up UI microcopy. Ping me when done. :thumbsup:
